SELECT id, title, state
FROM projects
WHERE status = 'qualified'
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 10;

INSERT INTO companies (project_id, name, domain)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.project_id }},
  '{{ ($json.company_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.domain || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)
RETURNING id;

UPDATE projects
SET status = 'enriched', status_at = now()
WHERE status = 'qualified'
  AND id IN (SELECT project_id FROM contacts);
